# BMX Cinemas (Balaji Movieplex)

> Premier entertainment hub redefining the movie-watching experience in Navi Mumbai and Ambernath with 4K Laser Projection, Dolby Atmos sound, and VIP recliner luxury.

## Pages & Key Services
- [Home Page](https://bmxcinemas.netlify.app/): Featured blockbusters, quick booking engine, trailers, Cine Cafe & theater experience.
- [About Us](https://bmxcinemas.netlify.app/about): Founded in 2013, history across Kopar Khairane, Kharghar, Ambernath, 6 USPs, and 9/12 Nau Se Barah Movie Bar.
- [Contact Us](https://bmxcinemas.netlify.app/contact): Outlet addresses, phone numbers (+91 88798 55831), and customer support form.
- [Careers](https://bmxcinemas.netlify.app/career): Job openings across Head Office, Restaurant, and Cinema outlets (hr@purpleparrots.in).
- [Advertise With Us](https://bmxcinemas.netlify.app/advertise): On-screen slides, trailers, lobby branding, and media kits.
- [Corporate Booking](https://bmxcinemas.netlify.app/corporate): Bulk bookings, private hall screenings, and corporate conference auditorium rentals (+91 79775 08036).
- [FAQs](https://bmxcinemas.netlify.app/faqs): Answers to ticketing, BookMyShow integration, amenities, and location questions.

## Outlets
- **Kopar Khairane**: Head Office, Plot No 90, Sector 8, Kopar Khairane, Navi Mumbai (+91 88798 55831).
- **Kharghar**: Little World Mall, Sector 2, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai (+91 87798 57813).
- **Ambernath**: GALAXY Mall, Vadol Gaon, Ambernath (+91 72086 80250).
